name: Tight line height
description: Line height below 1.3x the font size makes multi-line text hard to read. Use 1.5 to 1.7 for body text so lines have room to breathe.

name: Single font without hierarchy
description: Only one font family is used for the entire page. A single family can work when weight and size contrast carry the hierarchy; otherwise pair a distinctive display font with a refined body font.
